1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Enter a three character code on 12 large keys. Gentle, irregularly timed 3D motion begins after the second character.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Confirm the shown code by typing it with the physical keyboard.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Confirm the shown code using the on-screen keyboard.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Enter a four character code on 20 keys. Irregularly timed 3D motion begins after the first character.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Confirm the shown code by typing it with the physical keyboard.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Confirm the shown code using the on-screen keyboard.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Enter a five character code on 26 keys. Faster, irregularly timed 3D motion begins after the first character.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Confirm the shown code by typing it with the physical keyboard.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Confirm the shown code using the on-screen keyboard.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Enter a five character code on the current 32 key layout. Irregularly timed 3D motion begins after the first character and never repeats the same turn twice within one attempt.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Confirm the shown code by typing it with the physical keyboard.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Confirm the shown code using the on-screen keyboard.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Enter an eight character code on 32 smaller keys. Fast, sharply irregular 3D motion starts immediately.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Confirm the shown code by typing it with the physical keyboard.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Confirm the shown code using the on-screen keyboard.

simplified.summary: Type the shown code on the physical keyboard; the correct key does not move for this input surface.

full.summary: Click each on-screen key while it is readable and reachable under its independently timed 3D motion.
